subject: Quick calendar correction
text:
Hey all,

I just realized my earlier nudge might've crossed wires. I looked at the calendar and saw 'ops prep,' so I assumed we still had to finish the slide deck today. Turns out I read the wrong tab; that event was actually the vendor walkthrough, and the deck is due Friday. No rush on the draft. Please don't burn time tonight.

Also, could someone double-check the invite? If there's a second slot, I'll block it properly this time. Sorry for the mix-up. I'll fix the shared list so it's clearer. Thanks for bearing with me.

I've been juggling tabs like a rookie, so thanks for catching this before the meeting goes sideways. I'll tidy it up shortly, promise. Really appreciate it, team.
